rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an argument, explanation, or presentation that fails to persuade.

example.english: Your explanation is unconvincing, so nobody will believe it.
example.traditional: 你個解釋冇說服力，大家都唔會信。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 gaai2 sik1 mou5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 wui5 seon3

rows.note: Use this when the claim, story, or evidence itself seems not believable or credible.

example.english: His claim that he didn't take the document is unconvincing.
example.traditional: 佢話自己冇帶走份文件，但呢個講法唔可信。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 daai3 zau2 fan6 man4 gin6 daan6 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 m4 ho2 seon3

rows.note: Use this for reasoning or an explanation that feels forced or far-fetched rather than simply unpersuasive.

example.english: Linking two completely unrelated things like that is unconvincing.
example.traditional: 將兩件完全無關嘅事扯埋一齊，呢個推論未免太牽強。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 loeng5 gin6 jyun4 cyun4 mou4 gwaan1 ge3 si6 ce2 maai4 jat1 cai4 ni1 go3 teoi1 leon6 mei6 min5 taai3 hin1 koeng4
